items.title: 8. Health programs and population interventions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: 8. Health programs and population interventions: a main subheading of 22.1.2 Applications of Biostatistics, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 188-189.

blocks.text: Biostatistics sehat ke programmes aur poori population ke liye kiye gaye iqdamaat (interventions) ka asar naapti hai. Is se public health ke afsar samajhte hain ke teekon ki muhim (immunization campaigns), sehat ki taleem aur health workers ki training ka kya asar hua. Yeh jaanch wasail (resources) ko sahih jagah lagane aur public health ke kaamon ka faida barhane ke liye zaroori hai.
